# SC1005: orphan-module

## Meaning

The compiler emitted this diagnostic for orphan module. The declaration or generated contract violates a statically checkable SupaCloud rule.

## Fix

Inspect the module graph and change the dependency or scope declaration that triggered `orphan-module`. Keep dependencies one-way and make the smallest shared contract explicit.

## Reproduction

Place the example below in a focused compiler fixture and assert that `SC1005` is reported with a file location. The fixture must fail before the fix and pass after it.

## Failing Example

```ts
// Expected diagnostic: SC1005
@Module({ name: "orphan" })
export class OrphanModule {}
```
